system.description: Node-local state: this node's identity, peers, and internal bookkeeping.

local.description: One row describing this node: its host ID, datacenter, rack, tokens and release version.

columns.tokens: Token ranges owned by this node.

peers.description: What this node knows about the other nodes (legacy format, pre-4.0 clients).

peers_v2.description: What this node knows about the other nodes in the cluster, including their addresses and ports.

batches.description: Legacy storage for batches that were not yet applied.

batchlog.description: Batches awaiting replay so that an atomic batch is applied even if the coordinator fails.

available_ranges.description: Token ranges available on this node for streaming (legacy format).

available_ranges_v2.description: Token ranges that are already available on this node after bootstrap or rebuild.

built_views.description: Materialized views that have finished building on this node.

built_indexes.description: Secondary indexes that have finished building on this node.

IndexInfo.description: Records which secondary indexes were built on this node.

compaction_history.description: A log of past compactions: tables, sizes and timings.

hints.description: Hints stored for other nodes that were down during a write.

local_hints.description: Hints stored for other nodes that were down during a write.

paxos.description: State of lightweight transactions (Paxos) on this node.

paxos_repair_history.description: Records of Paxos repairs that have completed.

peer_events.description: Legacy record of events about peers.

prepared_statements.description: Prepared statements cached on this node, so they survive restarts.

range_xfers.description: Token ranges that were streamed to this node (legacy).

size_estimates.description: Estimated size of each token range per table, used by tools such as Spark connectors.

table_estimates.description: Estimated partition counts and sizes per table.

transferred_ranges.description: Token ranges that were streamed away from this node (legacy).

transferred_ranges_v2.description: Token ranges that were streamed away from this node.

view_builds_in_progress.description: Materialized views that are still building on this node.

materialized_views_builds_in_progress.description: Legacy list of materialized view builds in progress.

top_partitions.description: The largest and most-written partitions found by a top-partitions scan.

metadata_log.description: Cluster metadata change log (Transactional Cluster Metadata).

local_metadata_log.description: Local copy of the cluster metadata log.

consensus_migration_state.description: State of migrating tables between consensus protocols.

system_schema.description: The definitions of all keyspaces, tables, columns and other schema objects.

keyspaces.description: One row per keyspace with its replication settings.

tables.description: One row per table with its options (compaction, TTL, caching, ...).

columns.description: One row per column of every table and view, with type and key role.

dropped_columns.description: Columns that were dropped from tables.

column_masks.description: Dynamic data masking functions attached to columns.

system_auth.description: Authentication and authorization data: roles, their members and permissions.

roles.description: One row per role: whether it can log in, is superuser, and its password hash.

columns.salted_hash: Password hash. Always hidden by Helenus.
columns.can_login: Whether the role can log in.
columns.is_superuser: Whether the role bypasses all permission checks.

role_members.description: Which roles are members of which other roles.

role_permissions_index.description: Index of permissions by role, used internally.

resource_role_permissons_index.description: Index of permissions by resource, used internally.

identity_to_role.description: Maps authenticated identities (such as certificates) to roles.

network_permissions.description: Datacenters that each role may access.

cidr_groups.description: Named groups of IP ranges used for access control.

cidr_permissions.description: Which CIDR groups each role may connect from.

system_distributed.description: Cluster-wide bookkeeping, replicated to all nodes.

repair_history.description: History of repairs per table and token range.

parent_repair_history.description: History of repair sessions as a whole.

view_build_status.description: Per-node build status of each materialized view.

partition_denylist.description: Partitions that are blocked from reads and writes.

system_traces.description: Query tracing results written when tracing is enabled.

sessions.description: One row per traced request with its coordinator, duration and parameters.

events.description: The individual steps recorded during each traced request.

system_views.description: Virtual tables exposing live node state; nothing is stored on disk.

caches.description: Sizes and hit rates of the key, row and counter caches.

settings.description: The current value of every cassandra.yaml setting.

thread_pools.description: Activity of the node's internal thread pools.

system_properties.description: JVM and system properties of this node.

sstable_tasks.description: Running compactions and other SSTable operations with progress.

disk_usage.description: Disk space used by each table.

rows_per_read.description: Distribution of rows returned per read, per table.

tombstones_per_read.description: Distribution of tombstones scanned per read, per table.

local_scan_latency.description: Local range scan latency per table.

coordinator_read_latency.description: Read latency as seen by the coordinator, per table.

coordinator_write_latency.description: Write latency as seen by the coordinator, per table.

coordinator_scan_latency.description: Range scan latency as seen by the coordinator, per table.

internode_inbound.description: Inbound messaging between this node and its peers.

internode_outbound.description: Outbound messaging between this node and its peers.

pending_hints.description: Hints waiting to be delivered to other nodes.

repairs.description: Repair sessions known to this node.

batch_metrics.description: Metrics about logged and unlogged batches.

cql_metrics.description: Metrics about prepared and regular CQL statements.

gossip_info.description: The gossip state this node holds about every node.

queries.description: Currently running queries on this node.

sai_column_indexes.description: Storage Attached Index status per column.

sai_sstable_indexes.description: Storage Attached Index status per SSTable.

sai_view_indexes.description: Storage Attached Index status per index segment.

top_tombstone_partitions.description: Partitions with the most tombstones per table.

system_virtual_schema.description: Schema of the virtual tables in system_views.

columns.description: The columns of each virtual table.
